blocks.text:
SELECT . A.PLAYER_NAME AS 선수명, A BACK_NO AS 백넘버
, B.REGION_NAME AS 연고지, B.TEAM_NAME AS 팀명
FROM PLAYER A, TEAM B
WHERE A.POSITION = '6K'
AND B.TEAM_ID = A. TEAM_ID
